_purpose: Maps UT1 blacklist category names to ChmaraX/forensix#137 core taxonomy labels.
_authoring_rule: Every mapping below was authored from UT1's OWN published category description (research/_raw/137/ut1-index_en.html, the 66-category table) matched against the frozen boundary rule of the target label in research/137-taxonomy-proposal.md section 3. No fixture row, domain, or title was consulted. This is what keeps the family-5 candidate's supervision independent of the held-out set.
_licence: UT1 blacklists: CC BY-SA 4.0, Universite Toulouse 1 Capitole, https://dsi.ut-capitole.fr/blacklists/. A compiled table derived from them is a derivative work with share-alike obligations.
_alias_policy: UT1 publishes several categories twice under English and French names, and publishes three variants of its redirector list. Exactly one of each alias group is consumed; the others are listed in `excluded_aliases` with the reason. Consuming both would double-count identical hosts.
_threat_axis_policy: malware, phishing, cryptojacking, ddos, stalkerware, dialer and fakenews are REPUTATION verdicts about a domain today, not content categories about what a page is. research/137-taxonomy-proposal.md decision D-18 keeps threat structurally separate from the content taxonomy, and a history row is a claim about the past while a reputation feed is a claim about the present. They are excluded, not mapped.
_sexual_education_trap: UT1's own description of `sexual_education` reads 'Website which talk about sexual education, and can be misdetected as porn'. Taxonomy label 14 explicitly excludes sex education and routes it to Health & Medical. Mapping it to adult_sexual_content would manufacture the single most damaging false positive this tool can make, on the one label the fixture cannot score. Mapped to health_medical.

excluded_aliases.porn: alias of `adult` (both 17M, identical content published under two names); `adult` is consumed
excluded_aliases.drugs: alias of `drogue`; both excluded as overlay-pack labels, see excluded_overlay
excluded_aliases.aggressive: alias of `agressif`; both excluded (no core label; aggression is not a content category in this taxonomy)
excluded_aliases.strict_redirector: variant of `redirector` with the same hosts; `redirector` is consumed
excluded_aliases.strong_redirector: variant of `redirector` with the same hosts; `redirector` is consumed

excluded_threat_axis.malware: reputation verdict, not content; decision D-18
excluded_threat_axis.phishing: reputation verdict, not content; decision D-18
excluded_threat_axis.cryptojacking: reputation verdict about compromise, not the subject's cryptocurrency activity; mapping it to cryptocurrency_exchanges would assert an act by the user that a hijack does not evidence
excluded_threat_axis.fakenews: an editorial-quality verdict about a publisher, not a content category; asserting it in a forensic report is a conclusion the tool cannot support

excluded_overlay.drogue: maps to the opt-in overlay label Drugs & Controlled substances, which is out of scope for this bench run (taxonomy.json overlay_in_scope=false)
excluded_overlay.warez: maps to the opt-in overlay label Piracy & Copyright infringement, out of scope for this bench run
excluded_overlay.sect: proximate to religious belief, a GDPR Article 9 special category; decisions D-15/D-16 declined to create such a label
excluded_overlay.associations_religieuses: religious association; same Article 9 reasoning as `sect`
excluded_overlay.astrology: no core label; would route to entertainment or reference by page role, which a domain list cannot determine
excluded_overlay.child: an audience-suitability verdict, not a content category
excluded_overlay.arjel_note: arjel IS consumed (French gambling certification authority) and is listed in `mapping`

excluded_administrative.examen_pix: UT1's own description says DO NOT USE outside French PIX exams
excluded_administrative.tricheur_pix: UT1's own description says DO NOT USE
excluded_administrative.reaffected: UT1 housekeeping category, not a content category
excluded_administrative.agressif: no core label in this taxonomy
excluded_administrative.jstor: single-publisher allowlist, too narrow to be a category
excluded_administrative.manga_note: manga IS consumed and is listed in `mapping`
excluded_administrative.violence: no core label; violence is not a content category in this taxonomy and is adjacent to the overlay pack
